gloss: large, medium, and small; all sizes

definitions.gloss: large, medium, and small; all three sizes; ranging from large to small
definitions.explanation: A set expression listing the three standard size categories. Used when referring to the full range of sizes available, or to indicate variety in scale.

examples.japanese: ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{大中小|だいちゅうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧つです。
examples.english: The sizes are large, medium, and small.

examples.japanese: {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧にします⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Which would you like: large, medium, or small?

examples.japanese: {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}さまざまな⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{参加|さんか}している→参加する：25408_sankasuru⟧。
examples.english: Companies of all sizes — large, medium, and small — are participating in this project.

notes:
A fixed three-character compound of {大|だい} (large), ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (medium), and {小|しょう} (small). Functions as a concise way to express the full range of sizes. Extremely common in menus, product descriptions, and size selections.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|さん}→三：00749_san⟧⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧: three sizes (large, medium, small)
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}さまざま: of various sizes
- {大中小|だいちゅうしょう}⟦どれ→どれ：00547_dore⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: any size, regardless of size

USAGE:
At ramen shops and other restaurants, ordering by size often uses {大|だい} (large), ⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (regular/medium), and {小|しょう} (small) individually. The combined form {大中小|だいちゅうしょう} refers to all three as a set.
